description: Compares a candidate network, issuer and currency code against the canonical ASTEROID identity and returns a field-by-field result. The display symbol ASTEROID alone is never sufficient verification.

currencyCode.description: Currency code to check — the exact 160-bit hex code. Required for a match.

issuer.description: XRPL issuer address to check. Required for a match.

network.description: Network identifier to check, e.g. "xrpl-mainnet". Required for a match.

name: verify_asset
title: Verify an ASTEROID asset identity
